title: Propose conditional κ 0.003645372367832 from two funded cuts
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Propose conditional **κ = 0.003645372367832**, a gain of **0.000000482299892** over exact [#7161](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7161) and **0.000015314197832** over selected #7000. Please review this as a candidate for the conditional frontier. The proposed certificate retains the five framework assumptions.

Two charged rank-one exits extend donors 988 and 991 to the common return chart. The rank-four cut at chart 1091 produces equal responses on the donors. Their later difference at the rank-eight cut in chart 245 cancels that response and permits a second retirement. The emitted word preserves the original event order. It passes the arbitrary-input endpoint and actual pre-COPY destination guard.

The per-native changes are `T1 +1, T4 +1, T5 +1, T8 −1, P1 +2`. All 17 [#7113](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7113) stages pay both exits. The complete invoice has 22,461 productive fields, 110,553 paid positions, rank surplus 1,424 and no empty-root credit. The raw crossing is about 0.003645372367832704847. The fixed-profile packing ceiling is about 0.0058069138997, of which the claim realizes about 62.78%.

## Task and overlap

Canonical base `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. The exact native comparator is `e3f8d39c43b07063dfc5b800f71c5d21015259e6` and the signed caller is `07a76c5e2738882c0cb322278e56f6cae3c9885d`. The refreshed #7161 and #7164 heads add only the historical replay repair and leave their scientific package bytes intact. The revision-8 `p104-side-correction` scope changes from a same-cut test to two literal cuts with a guarded cross-response check. [Exact scope claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19539916)

The separate first commit reuses the exact selected-replay navigation prerequisite carried by #7161 following #7147/#7156. Six local navigation tests pass.

The final commit reuses the existing historical replay repair from [#7161](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7161) and [#7164](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7164). The initial [historical CI job](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/43017140111/job/130513219315?pr=7244) found `working source drift: Makefile`. The repair pins the historical replay to its inspected commit, and the registered historical replay passes locally. The two-cut package tree remains `f201bc8b5d1402ca40e7aa419269a58b7724798d`.

## Validation

CPython 3.12. The package regenerates the literal candidate from the exact source and witness. The native stage verifies every arbitrary-input coefficient, guarded timing, the 1125/F25 grid, all 70 owned lifetimes, affected 512-column Gaussian maps and absolute phase. The signed stage reconstructs the exact 17-stage word, its complete physical catalogue and price, the ordinary and precision bills, and all 54 strict and four functional outer predicates. Both directed prices reject the previous complete invoice at the new claim. The proposed frontier verifier independently checks all nine outer savings and insufficient BIT mutations.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-two-cut-funded-split
```
